title: Les activités de l’homme au village et en ville
through_line: Une journée qui commence au village et finit en ville.

blocks.vo_line: Au village, on pêche, on élève des animaux et on cultive la terre.
blocks.shot: A Cameroonian village on a river bank with red laterite earth and oil palms, a fisherman casting a net from a wooden pirogue, goats grazing, a man hoeing a field.

blocks.vo_line: On y fait aussi l’artisanat, les danses traditionnelles et la cuisine.
blocks.shot: A Cameroonian village square under a mango tree: a potter shaping a clay jar, dancers in traditional cloth, a woman cooking over a wood fire with a large pot.

blocks.vo_line: En ville, on travaille dans les bureaux, les écoles et les hôpitaux.
blocks.shot: A calm Cameroonian town street with low concrete buildings without any sign, red earth at the roadside, a yellow shared taxi, people walking to work.

blocks.vo_line: Il y a aussi les petits métiers : le call box et les vendeurs ambulants.
blocks.shot: A Cameroonian street corner with a small call box stand under a parasol and a street vendor carrying goods on his head.
